issues.title: Closed, solid mesh
issues.message: The model has 4 open edges and 4 non-manifold edges, so it is not a sealed solid. The slicer may fill it wrongly or skip parts of it.
issues.suggestion: Close the holes in your CAD tool or run a repair (e.g. Windows 3D Builder, PrusaSlicer 'Repair', or Meshmixer 'Make Solid') and re-export.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This large part is thin on average (about 0.89 mm). It may flex or warp.
issues.suggestion: Add ribs or thicken the thinnest sections.
